craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 49. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 7. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Said indeed: of own and other consciousness, own consciousness more powerful in overriding; that which overrides, of equality and indifference so.
l4.sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ hi svānyasaṃvittyoḥ svasaṃvidbalavattarā bādhakatve bādhikāsau sāmyaudāsīnyayostathā
